concepts.name: Platform Deployment Configuration
concepts.summary: Kubernetes deployment configuration for the whole ORISO platform: infrastructure (MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis), Keycloak, backend services (Tenant, User, Agency, ConsultingType, Upload), frontend & admin, communication (Matrix Synapse, Element, LiveKit), and monitoring (SigNoz, Health Dashboard).

concepts.name: Legacy Status (superseded by ORISO-Helm)
concepts.summary: This repository is archived/read-only upstream (Neusta-owned). Active deployment has moved to the ORISO-Helm repository; treat these manifests as historical reference, not as the live deployment path.

concepts.name: ConfigMaps, Helm & Ingress
concepts.summary: The repo groups its manifests into configmaps/ (service configuration), helm/ (charts), and ingress/ (routing/TLS) with docs/ describing procedures.
